ModMetaData.name: Construction Pipeline Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces repeated active construction validation and redundant zero-cost terrain work selection.
This historical build supports RimWorld 1.0 single-player. Multiplayer support begins with RimWorld 1.5.
Requires Harmony. No settings or save data. Do not enable this with Construction Queue Optimizer because that legacy package contains the same patches.
